caplan2007.geometry: quarter-scale flat Big-Blade outline; no curvature
caplan2007.extraction: native embedded raster filled-square centres; axes x=104.5..920 for 0..180deg; y=269,107.5 pixels/unit
caplan2007.exclusions: 45deg overlapping markers; 0/180 overlap used only as training boundaries
caplan2007.uncertainty: +/-2.5 pixels is a digitization bound, not experimental uncertainty

barre2010.geometry: 0.300m chord x 0.140m height rectangular flat blade
barre2010.extraction: PDF vector paths; Fig8 and5 right panels only to avoid duplicate data; Fig11 marker shapes
barre2010.uncertainty: coordinates rounded in publication; assume +/-0.15 PDF point for sensitivity, not sensor accuracy
barre2010.limitations: Fig11 K groups have different fr ranges; leave-K-out within overlap only. Actual lever not specified in accessible table; no inferred dimensional Fx test.

reijtenbagh2026.quantity: Fa=FD-FQS; dry plate/strut inertia already removed
reijtenbagh2026.extraction: solid coloured PDF paths; published theoretical dashed paths excluded
reijtenbagh2026.limitations: Nominal motion differs from actual robot motion (Appendix A). Some force paths clip at Fa=0; source curves are filtered. Paper model is itself calibrated on related experiments.
